description: Turn one product photo into UGC style product photos: a review, unboxing, or demo photo for ads and listings. Write the caption after you download.
h1: UGC Style Product Photos for Ads and Listings
lead: Booking a creator for every product slows the next post. UGC here means a creator-style photo. Upload one product photo and the person in it is generated, not hired.
steps_h2: How to Make UGC Style Product Photos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Upload the product, pick a creator-style scene, then download a photo for the feed.

steps.d: Upload one product photo with the package or product complete and easy to see. That file is the source for every scene you make.
Pick a routine, unboxing, or demo. Add a script line if you want one.
Download the photo and add the caption or offer in your own editor. Keep prices and claims as text you can edit later.

faq.q: What is a UGC style product photo?
faq.a: UGC means a creator-style photo. Upload one product photo and get a review, unboxing, or demo photo, without filming a creator. The person in the frame is generated.

faq.q: Do I have to describe the whole scene?
faq.a: No. Upload the product photo and pick a routine, unboxing or demo. One short line about the room or the light is optional.
Ecommerce sellers, marketers and agencies that need social photos for ads, carousels and product pages without booking a shoot.

faq.q: Where do the square photos fit?
faq.a: They fit Instagram and TikTok posts, carousels, and product galleries. For a Story that fills the phone, place the square on a tall frame in your editor.
Yes. Upload one product photo, choose a style and download the result. You do not need editing experience.

faq.q: Can I make several scenes from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same photo for a routine, an unboxing or a demo. Each scene is its own job, and the cost is shown before it starts.

faq.q: What does a creator-style photo cost, and can it run as an ad?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed run puts those credits back. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in your own ads, pages, and posts. You are still responsible for the claims in the ad and for any note the ad must show.

faq.q: When should I make a video instead?
faq.a: This template starts as a photo. Add a spoken line, captions, and music here, and open [creator-style video ads](page:video-ads) when the ad needs motion.

faq.q: Can the line use another language?
faq.a: Yes. Write or generate the line in the language you sell in. The same product photo can be the source.

faq.q: Can I edit what comes back?
faq.a: Yes. Trim a clip in the built-in editor, or change the caption after download. The square photo does not print a price into the file.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a product page and the script writer drafts the line. The photo on this page still starts from your product photo.
